d: Eternal founder Deepinder Goyal's ₹85,000 wearable forehead device, Temple, has drawn heavy criticism from clinical scientists and doctors questioning its unverified claims of measuring real-time brain blood flow. While Goyal defends the gadget as a non-diagnostic wellness and AI tool, medical experts warn that the sensors only capture superficial circulation rather than deep cerebral blood flow. Hem Kaur Saroya explains.
